items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: Ed Hacker, a great, great guy. ... it’s Ed Hacker — my old high school teacher.

ctx.x: Okay so I’m imagining that you were a big deal. “Ronnie has a gig.”

You know it’s funny, my family was, the Zito name was a big deal because my brothers went to that school and they’d say, “Oh Ronnie Zito’s coming in, we’re going to get another Zito.” And that would put me under pressure man. I’d be like oh no, because I was the youngest you know. And it was great, it was great. We had great music teachers. Ed Hacker, a great, great guy. As a matter of fact I was playing like one of the — someone paged me at the stage door after the show “Chicago” and I go to the stage door man,…
Ronnie, did you study with the drum teacher that Jimmy Wormworth did, Babe something?
